name: page
title: Page foundation
description: One path-driven pages collection, typed layouts, translations, and SEO.

files.content:
---
import { render } from "astro:content"
import type { AstroComponentFactory } from "astro/runtime/server/index.js"

import { getPages, type Page } from "@/lib/pages"
import OverviewLayout from "@/layouts/overview.astro"
import PageLayout from "@/layouts/page.astro"

type Props = Page
const page = Astro.props
const pages = await getPages()
const { Content } = await render(page)
const layouts = { page: PageLayout, overview: OverviewLayout } satisfies Record<
  Page["data"]["type"],
  AstroComponentFactory
>
const Layout = layouts[page.data.type]
---

<Layout page={page} pages={pages}><Content /></Layout>

---
type: page
title: About
description: Tell visitors about your business.
---

Write your content here. The layout owns its presentation.

---
type: overview
title: Welcome
description: Explore our website.
---

Add Markdown files here. The folder tree is your URL tree.

--- import type { Page } from "@/lib/pages" import Base from "./base.astro" type Props = { page: Page; pages: Page[] } const { page } = Astro.props ---

{page.data.title}

{page.data.description}

import { reference } from "astro:content"

// getPages validates this target type alongside normal collection references.
export const pageReference = <T extends string>(type: T) =>
  reference("pages").transform((value) => ({ ...value, expectedType: type }))
